entry.vector: 0 px/s of camera travel — there is no in-phone camera. .screen-world holds scale 1 / x 0 / y 0 for the whole scene and the device never transforms. The settings menu (profile card + the five .srow rows) is fully rendered at t=0; the only thing in motion at the cut is the oversized cursor, which is parked off the bottom screen edge at (320, 1030) and starts its travel at 0.8s.

exit.vector: 0 px/s — static from 11.8s. The cursor comes to rest on התנתקות at 10.95s, its row wash settles at 11.8s, and nothing moves for the final 0.2s. Frame 21's arrival is a stage-level move that does not need an inbound in-phone vector to invert.

notes.first_second: settings menu present and still at t=0 — no creep, no push. Stage kicker 0.3s, title 0.45s, the five stage chips 0.95s (each dimmed until its row is visited); cursor enters from the bottom edge at 0.8s.
notes.last_second: the cursor is parked on התנתקות, its wash settling to 0.45 opacity by 11.8s; the final 0.2s is a held frame with both screens at rest.
notes.staged_reveals: the 20% retime came out of the dead air between clicks — every travel leg and every read still runs long enough to follow. 0.8-2.6s cursor reads the profile row (hover wash, no navigation). 2.75s העדפות is clicked (press + ripple) and 3.0-3.7s the preferences view pushes in from the RTL start edge while the menu leaves; the card lands on back.out(1.3). Then one group per narration beat: מועדוני נאמנות 3.6-5.0s (all TEN clubs from the clubs collection cascading at 0.045s stagger, then asserting together at 4.55s), רמת התאמה 5.15-6.25s (בינוני popping at 5.8s), קטגוריות מושתקות 6.15-6.78s, the שמירת הגדרות button sliding up at 6.95s, the save press at 7.65s and ההגדרות נשמרו at 7.85s. 8.6s the back press returns to the menu (8.75-9.26s), and the last three rows — בנקאות פתוחה 9.45s, שפה 10.15s, התנתקות 11.0s — take one narration beat each.
notes.club_cloud: the מועדוני נאמנות group is the real app screen: a wrapping .pchip cloud carrying all ten clubs from the lessley.clubs collection, names verbatim (Mastercard Israel · Isracard TopCash · Hever (חבר) — Gift Cards · Hever (חבר) — טעמים · PaisPlus · PaisPlus — Food Chains Cash Card · PaisPlus — Networks Cash Card · HOT Israel · Behatsdaa · Swish (נפשונית)). Glyphs follow the app's emojiForClub(): a name carrying 'card' gets the card mark, everything else the ticket fallback — both as inline SVG because headless Chrome has no emoji font. The group runs one step tighter than the other two clouds (14px / 8px gaps) so ten long, script-mixing names wrap inside the card instead of pushing the save button off the screen, and each name is bidi-isolated on an LTR base direction so it reads exactly as spelled.
notes.camera_target: none. Both data-camera-target attributes from the sketch have been removed; nothing zooms.
